title: Ask for more time
subtitle: When the day's time runs out, Riley can ask, and a parent answers from anywhere.

steps.say: Riley has used all of today's time, and the homework isn't done.
Riley asks for half an hour and says why.
The request goes straight to the parents, on the dashboard at home or on a parent's phone.
A parent approves it, and Riley gets the answer right away.
Thirty more minutes, and the internet is back on.
